title: Sketching the Cartoon Guy
content: Yesterday I visited theDutchess County Fair in Rhinebeck, New York. It was early in the morning on opening day.A caricaturist named Mark, the “Cartoon Guy,” was set up under his white tent, waiting for customers.I did a blog post about Markthree years ago. He had a new sign out that said “Please don’t text while you’re posing.”I hung out with him until he got his first customer of the day, a girl who had never been drawn before. During a lull Mark and I drew each others’ portrait.Previously: "The Cartoon Guy"
